WHAT'S YOUR RETURN AND REFUND POLICY?
You can request a return within 14 DAYS OF RECEIVING YOUR ITEM. It must be unworn or unused, with tags attached, in its original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. Start a request through our RETURN PORTAL.
Once we receive and inspect an eligible return, we issue the refund to your original payment method within 10 BUSINESS DAYS; your bank may take additional time to post it.
